# F20: With no set check-in rhythm, no screen says what is due, late, quiet or on time, at either width

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/20-no-rhythm.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

with no set check-in rhythm, nothing says what is due, late or on time (FT1, docs/design/feature-toggles/spec.md section 9). As Amara, an admin, the rhythm is set to none on Features; then, as Rhea, an owner, at 1440 and 390 px, none of the core screens says “No recent update”, “due by”, “to do”, “streak”, “on time”, or “Can’t say”, and a goal's History has no “No check-in” row. (Reviews off is FT2's half: N21.)

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.
